environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: The planned product publishes identifiable profile photographs, video and biographical data for promotional purposes.
expected: Every person and media asset has verified majority age, informed publication consent, purpose/scope/duration, withdrawal and rights evidence linked to the exact public release.
observed: The data model and release validation require evidence references and rights metadata, and no real profiles are committed. No actual identity, consent, image-rights, licence or withdrawal package was supplied for a release.
method: Static review of profile/media types, validation gates, source inventory and legal-input register.
preconditions: Only synthetic records exist in automated tests.
limitations: Authenticity, authority, territorial scope and revocation status cannot be assessed without the restricted rights package.
impact: Publishing without valid evidence could cause unlawful or unauthorised exposure of identifiable people and make withdrawal or takedown unreliable.
prevalence: Every profile, photo, video, thumbnail, social preview and derivative asset.

false_positive_analysis: The code's strong evidence gates and absence of real media prevent current public exposure, but they do not prove that future evidence exists or is legally sufficient.
counterevidence: No real profile or media is committed.
Publication validation requires adult-age, consent and rights evidence references.
remediation_minimum: Collect and verify a restricted, versioned rights package per person and asset; link it to the release manifest; define scope, duration, withdrawal, takedown, derivatives and responsible reviewer before publication.
additional_hardening: Automate expiry/revocation checks and a tested emergency unpublish procedure without copying sensitive evidence into public logs.
suggested_owner: Client rights owner, privacy owner and Spanish legal counsel
effort: External evidence per asset plus medium workflow work
retest: Select a non-sensitive sample in staging and trace approval, publication, withdrawal and complete removal from page, cache and derivatives.
residual_risk: NO-GO for real profiles or media until every item has current verified evidence and counsel-approved use.
